images.prompt: Create a production pixel-art environment atlas for the game Defesa Zumbi. Reference image supplies ONLY the eight biome identities, palette and crisp outlined 16-bit pixel-art style. Completely redraw the terrain composition; do NOT preserve the narrow paths. Output one portrait atlas in 8:9 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x2304, with EXACTLY 2 columns and 4 equal rows, zero gaps, zero borders. Each of the 8 cells is a complete wide 16:9 first-person stationary defense background. IMPORTANT GAME GEOMETRY in EACH cell: horizon at 35% height. Open walkable ground from 38% height to the bottom, a very broad flat clearing, not a narrow road. The unobstructed area must include the trapezoid with vertices (22%,40%),(78%,40%),(100%,82%),(100%,100%),(0%,100%),(0%,82%). The entire bottom 25% must contain ONLY flat ground. Put all buildings, trees, fences, logs, barrels, boulders, benches and equipment outside that polygon, at far left/right or BEHIND the horizon. No raised objects or water within the walkable polygon. This is a continuous natural ground painting, not an overlay: subtle small dirt patches, tiny surface pebbles, flat cracks, soft color variations; believable perspective, no big repetitive lines or patterned tiles, no lane markings, no grid, no numbers, no text, no UI, no characters, no weapons, no zombies, no central props. Flat playable surfaces must remain legible for silhouettes. Rich atmospheric scenery around the edges, not empty monochrome floors. Consistent ground-plane projection across ALL eight cells.
